field.description: A field by its path, such as contact.services or deal.value.

outputs.description: The event that met the goal; absent when it was not met.

leaves.label: Lead source
leaves.description: The lead source worked out for the touch, as people read it, such as Google Ads (lead-sources.ts lists the built-in names). Empty for a touch that was not a visit, such as a contact added by hand.

leaves.label: Lead source rule
leaves.description: The rule that decided the lead source: a built-in rule by its key, such as google_ads, which stays the same if the name is ever reworded.

leaves.label: Session source
leaves.description: The channel the visit came through, such as paid_search.

leaves.label: Medium
leaves.description: The kind of interaction that recorded the touch, such as form.

leaves.label: UTM source
leaves.description: utm_source of the page the visitor arrived on.

leaves.label: UTM medium
leaves.description: utm_medium of the page the visitor arrived on.

leaves.label: UTM campaign
leaves.description: utm_campaign of the page the visitor arrived on.

leaves.label: UTM content
leaves.description: utm_content of the page the visitor arrived on.

leaves.label: UTM term
leaves.description: utm_term (or utm_keyword) of the page the visitor arrived on.

leaves.label: Match type
leaves.description: The keyword match type an ad link carried.

leaves.label: Campaign ID
leaves.description: The campaign id an ad link carried.

leaves.label: Ad group ID
leaves.description: The ad group (or ad set) id an ad link carried.

leaves.label: Ad ID
leaves.description: The ad id an ad link carried.

leaves.label: Referrer domain
leaves.description: The host of the site the visitor came from.

leaves.label: Landing page
leaves.description: The page the visitor arrived on, without its query.

leaves.label: Page
leaves.description: The page the form was sent from or the booking was made on, without its query.

leaves.label: Date
leaves.description: When the touch was recorded.

leaves.label: Has a Google click ID
leaves.description: Whether the touch holds a Google Ads click id (gclid, gbraid or wbraid). The id itself is never given.

leaves.label: Has a Meta click ID
leaves.description: Whether the touch holds a Facebook or Instagram click id (fbclid, or a click-to-WhatsApp id). The id itself is never given.

leaves.label: Has a Microsoft click ID
leaves.description: Whether the touch holds a Microsoft Advertising click id (msclkid). The id itself is never given.

leaves.label: Has a TikTok click ID
leaves.description: Whether the touch holds a TikTok click id (ttclid). The id itself is never given.

leaves.label: Has a LinkedIn click ID
leaves.description: Whether the touch holds a LinkedIn click id (li_fat_id). The id itself is never given.
